description: This file defines a class 'EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It is responsible for configuring menu items related to employment status within the OrangeHRM system, specifically overriding screen details for the employment status menu.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu settings for employment status, including overriding screen details for this module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'employmentStatus' using helper trait function and returns null.
